$comment: Pins for the corpus conformance gate (tool/conformance.dart).
The reference implementation and the corpus are both pinned so a failure
always means this SDK changed, never that the world moved underneath it.
Bumping either pin is a deliberate, reviewable act: update the version,
the checksum, expectedAssetCount, and any newly accepted divergence in
c2patool 0.27.22 bundles c2pa 0.90.22, which is the version declared in
tool/compatibility.json. Checksums are of the published release archives.
binaryPath/binarySha256 are checked on every run, including when the
binary comes from the CI cache. The archive digest alone would not
cover that path, and workflow caches are writable from any branch.
The C2PA organisation's public conformance assets: signed by many
different producers, so they exercise encodings this SDK never
writes itself. Pinned to a commit so the gate measures this SDK.
Fixtures vendored from c2pa-rs 0.90.22 and checked in under
test/fixtures/vendor. Needs no download, so it also keeps the gate
meaningful if the public corpus is ever unreachable.

$knownDivergences: Corpus-relative asset path -> the difference kinds accepted for it.
